about: Values added on 13 Nov 2026 (Run B): climate-aware cooling, cooling lead times and plant costs, an air-cooled rack, Vera Rubin rack power.

values.label: Facility water supply at the CDU rating point
values.source_title: Vertiv CoolChip CDU 2300kW data sheet (SL-80005)
values.note: Vertiv, a data center power and cooling maker, rates its largest CDU at 32 C facility water, the ASHRAE W32 class (formerly W3).

values.label: ASHRAE liquid cooling classes, facility water supply upper limits
values.source_title: What You Need to Know About ASHRAE's Fifth Edition of Thermal Guidelines
values.publisher: Upsite Technologies (article by a voting member of ASHRAE TC 9.9)
values.quote: the classes are now W17, W27, W32, NEW class W40, W45
values.note: ASHRAE, the US heating and cooling engineers' society, names its liquid classes by their facility water limit: 17, 27, 32, 40 and 45 C. Used as the bounds of the supply input.

values.label: Facility water supply, where liquid-cooled sites are converging
values.source_title: Hot water, cold water
values.note: Cross-check for the default.

values.label: CDU approach temperature
values.source_title: Vertiv CoolChip CDU 2300kW data sheet (SL-80005)
values.note: Secondary (rack loop) outlet 36 C at 32 C primary inlet.

values.label: CDU pump power per kW of heat
values.source_title: Vertiv CoolChip CDU 2300kW data sheet (SL-80607)
values.note: 47.8 kW nominal power / 2,300 kW nominal capacity.

values.label: Plate heat exchanger approach (free-cooling exchanger)
values.source_title: SIGMA M186 plate heat exchanger brochure
values.quote: a standard heat exchanger typically operates with a 2 °C temperature approach
values.note: API Heat Transfer, a heat exchanger maker. Xylem gives 2 F (1.1 K) as the practical minimum.

values.label: Dry cooler approach to outdoor dry-bulb
values.source_title: Free Cooling for Saving Energy: Technical Market Analysis of Dry, Wet, and Hybrid Cooling Based on Manufacturer Data (Energies 16(9), 3661)
values.publisher: Wenzel, Muehlen and Radgen, University of Stuttgart (Energies, peer reviewed)
values.quote: dry cooling has an approach of 10 K to DBT at the median
values.note: Median over manufacturer data. Bounds 4 to 15 K are our choice for the input.

values.label: Open cooling tower approach to outdoor wet-bulb
values.source_title: Free Cooling for Saving Energy: Technical Market Analysis of Dry, Wet, and Hybrid Cooling Based on Manufacturer Data (Energies 16(9), 3661)
values.publisher: Wenzel, Muehlen and Radgen, University of Stuttgart (Energies, peer reviewed)
values.quote: open wet cooling enables a median approach of 5 K towards ambient WBT
values.note: Median over manufacturer data. Bounds 3 to 10 K are our choice for the input.

values.label: Open cooling tower electricity per kW of heat
values.source_title: Free Cooling for Saving Energy: Technical Market Analysis of Dry, Wet, and Hybrid Cooling Based on Manufacturer Data (Energies 16(9), 3661)
values.publisher: Wenzel, Muehlen and Radgen, University of Stuttgart (Energies, peer reviewed)
values.note: Midpoint of the open wet range.

values.label: Dry cooler fan power per kW of heat
values.source_title: Kelvion Select RT data sheet, dry cooler LF-PD203T4H-080Y06D
values.note: Kelvion, a heat exchanger maker: 6 fans at 1,708 W each = 10.25 kW for 515.87 kW. Inside the 0.01 to 0.06 range in Wenzel et al. (2023).

values.label: Air-cooled chiller full-load efficiency, code minimum
values.source_title: Washington State Energy Code, Table C403.3.2(3) (a replica of ASHRAE 90.1 Table 6.8.1-3)
values.note: EER 10.1 / 3.412 = COP 2.96 at standard rating conditions (7 C chilled water). With warm water the lift is smaller and the real COP is higher, so this is conservative.

values.label: Water-cooled centrifugal chiller full-load efficiency, code minimum
values.source_title: Washington State Energy Code, Table C403.3.2(3) (a replica of ASHRAE 90.1 Table 6.8.1-3)
values.note: 3.517 / 0.560 = COP 6.28 at standard rating conditions; conservative for warm water for the same reason.

values.label: Facility (chilled) water pumping power, ASHRAE 90.1 baseline
values.source_title: [Equest-users] App G Baseline CHW Pump Power (ASHRAE 90.1 Appendix G, G3.1.3.10)
values.publisher: Building simulation users' list, quoting ASHRAE 90.1 Appendix G (secondary)
values.note: ASHRAE 90.1 baseline design pump power; an ASHRAE interpretation counts it as the whole chilled water system.

values.label: Condenser water pumping power, ASHRAE 90.1 baseline
values.source_title: [Bldg-sim] 90.1 Appendix G pumping power question
values.publisher: Building simulation users' list, quoting ASHRAE 90.1 Appendix G (secondary)
values.quote: The condenser water pump will always be 19 w / gpm
values.note: Used for the tower (condenser) loop.

values.label: Fan wall power per kW of heat
values.source_title: Vertiv CoolLoop Thermal Wall data sheet (SL-70713)
values.note: Power input 25.5 kW / 500 kW for the CA80.

values.label: Fan wall entering water temperature, design
values.source_title: AireWall ONE brochure
values.note: Airedale, a cooling maker owned by Modine: minimum 14, maximum 26, design 20 C. Used for the air side of every hall and as the supply for air halls.

values.label: UPS efficiency, transformer-less double conversion
values.source_title: How to Achieve Lower PUE in Your Data Center
values.publisher: Mitsubishi Electric Power Products, UPS Division
values.note: UPS loss = 1/0.97 - 1 = 3.1% of IT.

values.label: Cooling tower evaporation, share of flow per 10 F of range
values.source_title: How Do You Calculate Water Loss in a Cooling Tower?
values.note: Delta Cooling Towers, a tower maker. 0.85% of the circulating flow per 10 F: 3,600 kJ / (4.186 x 5.56 K) x 0.0085 = 1.32 L per kWh of heat.

values.label: Cooling tower cycles of concentration
values.source_title: Conserve Water by Improving Cooling Tower Efficiency
values.quote: Towers operating at six to eight cycles are acceptable
values.note: Blowdown = evaporation / (cycles - 1). 5 cycles is the threshold POWER names; 6 to 8 is good practice.

values.quote: a stack of four DGX B200 systems is already pushing the limits

values.label: NVIDIA DGX B200 price per system (reseller listing)
values.source_title: NVIDIA Blackwell DGX B200 Listed, Prices Start At A Half A Million Dollars
values.note: Secondary: a reseller listing; NVIDIA publishes no list price. GPU Smith reports $450,000 to $600,000 street prices, used as the range.

values.label: Vera Rubin NVL144 rack power, second-hand reports
values.source_title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin reference architecture
values.note: NVIDIA's own Vera Rubin NVL72 page gives no rack power (checked 13 Nov 2026). Introl reported 120 to 130 kW from GTC 2025; Hashrate Index reports 190 to 230 kW. The figures conflict, so the value is marked uncertain and the range spans both.
